logic.par.text:
to microgrid_bid_score with solar_arrays as number, wind_turbines as number, storage_banks as number, interconnects as number, emergency_mode as yesno giving number:
    let generation be solar_arrays times 9 plus wind_turbines times 13
    let buffer be storage_banks times 3
    if emergency_mode:
        set buffer to storage_banks times 7
    let required be generation plus buffer
    let capacity be interconnects times 55
    let delivered be required
    if delivered is more than capacity:
        set delivered to capacity
    let shortfall be required minus capacity
    if shortfall is less than 0:
        set shortfall to 0
    let windows be number from (required divided by 31)
    give back delivered plus shortfall times 4 plus windows times 9

main.par.text:
include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text
a request_input has bid_key as text, solar_arrays as number, wind_turbines as number, storage_banks as number, interconnects as number, emergency_mode as yesno, duplicate_bid as yesno
a response_body has bid_key as text, generation_units as number, battery_buffer_units as number, grid_required_units as number, grid_capacity_units as number, delivered_units as number, shortfall_units as number, dispatch_windows as number, bid_score as number, bid_state as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Microgrid Bid", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with bid_key key, generation_units 0, battery_buffer_units 0, grid_required_units 0, grid_capacity_units 0, delivered_units 0, shortfall_units 0, dispatch_windows 0, bid_score 0, bid_state state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    let credential be (maybe item "x-grid-key" of request's headers) otherwise ""
    if credential is not "grid-045":
        set item "www-authenticate" of headers to "GridKey"
        give back a controlled_response with status 401, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "authorization_required")
    if body's solar_arrays is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "invalid")
    if body's wind_turbines is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "invalid")
    if body's storage_banks is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "invalid")
    if body's interconnects is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "invalid")
    if body's interconnects is 0:
        if body's solar_arrays times 9 plus body's wind_turbines times 13 is more than 0:
            set item "x-validation" of headers to "interconnects"
            give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "invalid")
    if body's duplicate_bid:
        set item "x-conflict" of headers to "duplicate_bid"
        give back a controlled_response with status 409, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's bid_key, "duplicate")
    let generation be body's solar_arrays times 9 plus body's wind_turbines times 13
    let buffer be body's storage_banks times 3
    if body's emergency_mode:
        set buffer to body's storage_banks times 7
    let required be generation plus buffer
    let capacity be body's interconnects times 55
    let delivered be required
    if delivered is more than capacity:
        set delivered to capacity
    let shortfall be required minus capacity
    if shortfall is less than 0:
        set shortfall to 0
    let windows be number from (required divided by 31)
    let state be "accepted"
    if shortfall is more than 0:
        set state to "routine_shortfall"
        if body's emergency_mode:
            set state to "emergency_shortfall"
    let result be a response_body with bid_key body's bid_key, generation_units generation, battery_buffer_units buffer, grid_required_units required, grid_capacity_units capacity, delivered_units delivered, shortfall_units shortfall, dispatch_windows windows, bid_score (microgrid_bid_score with body's solar_arrays, body's wind_turbines, body's storage_banks, body's interconnects, body's emergency_mode), bid_state state
    set item "location" of headers to "/api/v9/microgrid-bids/" plus body's bid_key
    set item "retry-after" of headers to "3"
    set item "x-bid-state" of headers to state
    give back a controlled_response with status 202, headers headers, body result
